files.notebook.md:
# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes

steps.line: * Given a notebook with the lines "# Tasks", "## Fix the reaper", "It leaks." and "# Notes" is open

drive.jq:
"# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
" as $t | ($t | index("# Tasks")) as $o | (.seenTasks // .opened).json as $s | $s.sections.notebook.drawn as $d | first(($d[] | select(.offset == $o) | .rect | if .y + .height / 2 < $s.window.content.height / 2 then -1 else 1 end), (if ($d | length) > 0 and $o < $d[0].offset then -1 else 1 end))

do.until:
"# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
" as $t | ($t | index("# Tasks")) as $o | any(.seenTasks.json.sections.notebook.drawn[]; .offset == $o)

steps.line: * When the user chooses View > Fold Heading

expect.that:
"# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
" as $t | ($t | index("## Fix the reaper")) as $h | ($t | index("It leaks.")) as $o | ($t | index("# Notes")) as $n | .folded.json.sections.notebook.drawn as $d | all($d[]; (.offset < $o or .offset >= $n) and (.text | contains("It leaks.") | not)) and any(range(0; ($d | length) - 1); $d[.].offset == $h and $d[. + 1].offset == $n)
expect.why: the window shows the heading and, next below it, the line after "It leaks.", but not "It leaks.": it is hidden, not scrolled out of the window

expect.that:
"# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
" as $t | ($t | index("# Notes")) as $n | any(.folded.json.sections.notebook.drawn[]; .offset == $n and (.text | rtrimstr("
")) == "# Notes")
expect.why: "# Notes" still starts where it did, so the characters of "It leaks." still lie before it in the text, only not shown

steps.line: * And "## Fix the reaper" shows the folded marker

expect.that:
"# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
" as $t | ($t | index("## Fix the reaper")) as $h | any(.folded.json.sections.notebook.folded[]; .offset == $h and (.line | rtrimstr("
")) == "## Fix the reaper")
expect.why: the heading is marked as folded

expect.that:
"# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
" as $t | ($t | index("## Fix the reaper")) as $h | .folded.json.sections.notebook as $nb | first($nb.drawn[] | select(.offset == $h)) as $p | ($p.text | rtrimstr("
")) == "## Fix the reaper" and any($nb.markers[]; .heading == $h and .rect.width > 0 and .rect.height > 0 and .rect.y < $p.rect.y + $p.rect.height and .rect.y + .rect.height > $p.rect.y)
expect.why: the window still shows the line "## Fix the reaper", with the folded marker beside it

steps.line: * And "# Tasks" and "# Notes" are visible

expect.that: .folded.json as $s | any($s.sections.notebook.drawn[]; (.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == "# Tasks" and .rect.width > 0 and .rect.height > 0 and .rect.x < $s.window.content.width and .rect.x + .rect.width > 0 and .rect.y < $s.window.content.height and .rect.y + .rect.height > 0)
expect.why: "# Tasks" is drawn inside the window's content

expect.that: .folded.json as $s | any($s.sections.notebook.drawn[]; (.text | rtrimstr("\n")) == "# Notes" and .rect.width > 0 and .rect.height > 0 and .rect.x < $s.window.content.width and .rect.x + .rect.width > 0 and .rect.y < $s.window.content.height and .rect.y + .rect.height > 0)
expect.why: "# Notes" is drawn inside the window's content
